title: Schedule the recurring data export
when: The step asks to set up or change the recurring backup export of org data on the Data Export page: how often it runs, when, and which data it includes. It is not Data Loader, not a report export, and not a one-off 'Export Now'.
steps: In the embedded Data Export page, click 'Schedule Export'.
Set the frequency, start and end dates and preferred start time the step asks for, leaving the rest as offered.
Tick 'Include all data' unless the step names specific objects.
doneWhen: The Data Export page shows a scheduled export with the requested frequency, and a 'next scheduled export' date.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 4 actions, 25 s, reviewer confirmed. A fresh session showed a saved 'Monthly Export Service' with a next scheduled export date. No model-free check exists for this page, so that fresh-session read is the evidence. Developer Edition offers monthly only; weekly is untested.

trial.step: Schedule the recurring data export to include all data, using the default dates.

notes: Frequency options depend on edition: weekly for Enterprise and up, monthly otherwise.
